ACTION=A2
The scene presents two simultaneous hazards: a vehicle cutting in from the right (y=3.5m) at 7.5 m/s and a cyclist crossing from the left (y=-5.0m) at 3.2 m/s. The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (~13.9 m/s). Given the proximity of the merging vehicle (27.2m ahead) and the crossing cyclist (34.2m ahead), maintaining speed or accelerating is unsafe. A moderate deceleration (A2) is required to create a safe gap for the merging vehicle and allow the cyclist to clear the path, while avoiding the excessive braking associated with A3 or A4 which might be unnecessary if the gaps are sufficient for a controlled slow-down.
